Marissa / team

Quick assessment after reviewing incident_log_20260416.pdf and the traffic summary Priya shared:
- Observed peak QPS: ~320 calls/s to generation API during the spike; average token generation ~350 tokens per request.
- Model variant: acme-prod-gpt-large (1.2B params after custom layers) 

warm KV cache sizing suggests ~40GB of model + KV working set.

Options & estimated timelines:
1) Dedicated (express provisioning):
   - Feasible. We can provision a dedicated pool sized for this workload (estimate: 4
8 x A100 40GB equiv depending on batching).
   - Express provisioning path: 48
72 hours if we use reserved pool with on-demand capacity and expedited infra. Requires an ops runbook, emergency SOW, and payment confirmation.
2) Private VPC (peering / customer-managed network):
   - More work: networking setup, cross-account peering, KMS/HSM integration and audit.
   - Estimated lead time: 3
6 weeks (depends on customer network readiness and approvals).
3) Short-term mitigations on Hosted:
   - Prefix caching and rate limiting can reduce error surface but will not fully eliminate the variability seen during promotion traffic.

Immediate asks from us to customer:
- PO/approval for express provisioning and confirmation on whether they accept the expedited pricing uplift (we should surface a number).
- Network CIDR & peering contact for Private evaluation.

I can lead the sizing/provisioning work if Connor/ops ok the escalation path.

-Hannah
